name: Workflowdone – Amazon affiliate Elementor Widget
author: workflowdone

sections.description:
Workflowdone – Amazon affiliate Elementor Widget is a WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates Amazon products into your Elementor-built pages. Display products in a beautiful grid layout with full Elementor customization options.

Free Features

  • Elementor Widget: Dedicated widget for displaying Amazon products with full Elementor customization
  • Easy Product Management: Add products one by one with optional custom titles and descriptions
  • Grid Layout: Display products in a configurable grid with adjustable columns
  • Product Information: Display title, description, price, discounts, and product images
  • Caching: Built-in caching system to minimize API calls and improve performance
  • Multiple Marketplaces: Support for all Amazon international marketplaces
  • Responsive Design: Beautiful on all devices with mobile-first design
  • Customizable Styling: Full control over colors, typography, spacing, and more

Pro Features (Supporter Pro License – $10 Lifetime for 3 Sites)

Upgrade to the Supporter Pro License to unlock additional features:

  • List Layout View: Display products in a horizontal list format
  • Hover Previews: Automatically show product previews when visitors hover over Amazon links anywhere in your content
  • Prime Badge Display: Show Prime eligibility badges on products
  • Priority Support: Get faster responses from our support team

Get the Supporter Pro License

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • Elementor 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Amazon Product Advertising API credentials (Access Key, Secret Key, Partner Tag)

How to Get Amazon API Credentials

  1. Sign up for the Amazon Associates Program at https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/
  2. Once approved, navigate to the Product Advertising API section
  3. Generate your Access Key and Secret Key
  4. Note your Partner Tag (Affiliate ID)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/workflowdone-amazon-affiliate-elementor-widget/ or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Amazon affiliate > Settings to configure your API credentials
  4. Use the “Amazon Products” widget in Elementor to display products
sections.faq:
How do I add products to the widget?

In the Elementor editor, add the “Amazon Products” widget to your page. In the widget settings, add items and paste Amazon product URLs or ASINs.

Can I use product URLs or ASINs?

Yes! The plugin accepts both full Amazon product URLs and 10-character ASINs. You can mix and match both formats.

Is the product data cached?

Yes, product data is cached to minimize API calls and improve page load times. You can configure the cache duration in the plugin settings (default is 24 hours).

Which Amazon marketplaces are supported?

The plugin supports all Amazon international marketplaces including US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Japan, India, Brazil, Mexico, Australia, Netherlands, Sweden, Poland, Singapore, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

How do I get List Layout and Hover Previews?

These are Pro features available with the Supporter Pro License. For just $10 (lifetime license for 3 sites), you can unlock List Layout, Hover Previews, Prime Badge display, and priority support. Upgrade here

Where can I get support?

For support, please email support@workflowdone.com or visit our website.
